name: Cubing Returns Ghaziabad 2022
information: ## NOTE: Competitor limit of 30 has been reached. Participants can still register on the waiting list and pay. In case of any cancellations, paid registrations from the waiting list will be accepted on a first-come-first-served basis. Participants on the waiting list are eligible for a refund till 4th March 2022 11:59 PM GMT+5:30. * Make sure you are present at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be accommodated under any circumstances. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or are not aware of competition rules, make sure you attend the **Tutorial for New Competitors**. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please carry an ID proof. All participants are expected to volunteer for the event when they are not participating. The roles could be of a judge, runner, or a scrambler, depending upon the situation. # COVID-19 Guidelines * One of the following proofs is mandatory for all participants and guests: 1. Proof of negative RTPCR within 72 hours from the competition date (i.e sample collected on/after 16th March) 2. Proof of full vaccination (both doses) with second dose at least 14 days prior to the competition date (i.e second dose on/before 5th March) * Participants and guests under the age of 5 are exempted from providing the above mentioned proof. * Participants and guests failing to submit the proof will not be allowed to enter the venue. **NO REFUND** will be given in that case. * Maximum **ONE** guest is allowed to accompany a participant inside the venue. We strongly encourage participants to not bring any guests as a COVID-19 preventive measure. * Wearing masks, sanitizing hands frequently and following all local goverment protocols is mandatory inside the venue.
